name: mackorn_catalog
description: List all MACKORN hydraulic cone crusher models with their max feed size, CSS range, motor power, weight and capacity. Use this when the user asks "what models do you have" / "你们有什么型号" / wants an overview before choosing.

name: mackorn_specs
description: Get the full cavity-by-CSS capacity table for one MACKORN model (e.g. NH400). Returns css_list and cavity_rows where each row has cavity code, max feed size and a [min,max] tph pair per CSS. Use this when the user names a specific model and asks for its specifications.

name: mackorn_capacity
description: Query the exact capacity range (t/h) for one MACKORN model at a given closed-side-setting (CSS) and optionally a cavity code. Returns min/max tph per cavity. If the CSS is not in the vendor table, returns available CSS list instead of interpolating. Use this when the user gives model + CSS and asks "how many tonnes per hour".

css.description: Closed side setting in mm. Must be one of the model css_list values.

cavity.description: Optional cavity code: EC/C/MC/M/MF/F/EF/EFX/EEF. Omit to get all cavities.

name: mackorn_recommend
description: Recommend MACKORN model tier(s) for a target capacity in t/h. Returns the smallest tier whose tphMax covers the request, with model options and motor power. If the target exceeds the largest single unit, returns EXCEEDS_SINGLE_UNIT instead of a wrong answer. Use this when the user says "I need 500 tonnes per hour, which model".

tph.description: Required capacity in tonnes per hour (t/h).

name: mackorn_materials
description: Look up MACKORN material library for ore/rock properties (hardness, abrasiveness, bond work index reference). Optional keyword filter, e.g. 花岗岩 / granite / 玄武岩 / 铁矿. Use this when the user mentions a specific ore type and you need to know how it affects crusher selection.

q.description: Optional keyword, e.g. '花岗岩', 'granite', 'iron ore'. Omit to list the library.

name: mackorn_liner
description: Get liner (wear part) life reference for MACKORN cone crushers, optionally per model. Use this when the user asks about wear parts, liner replacement interval, or operating cost.

model.description: Optional model code. Omit to return the whole table.
